title: المجموعة الثانية: الحياة اليومية والعادات
status: 18 complete authored patterns; realistic photos pending; voices only count after verification

items.title: I wake up
items.explanation: نستخدم wake up للحظة الاستيقاظ، ولا يعني بالضرورة مغادرة السرير؛ نقول at six عند الساعة السادسة.
items.explanationEn: Wake up means to stop sleeping. Use at before a clock time.
items.contrast: I wake up = أستيقظ، I get up = أنهض من السرير.

scenes.en: I wake up at six.
I wake up early.
I wake up at seven on Sunday.
I wake up when my alarm rings.

story.en: Maya wakes up at six.
She opens her eyes and smiles.
She says, 'I wake up early on school days.'
story.ar: تقول: أستيقظ مبكرًا في أيام المدرسة.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time do you wake up?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I wake up at six.

items.title: I get up
items.explanation: Get up يصف النهوض فعليًا من السرير. يمكن أن تستيقظ أولًا ثم تنهض بعد دقائق.
items.explanationEn: Get up means to leave your bed. You can wake up before you get up.
items.contrast: Wake up لحظة انتهاء النوم، وGet up مغادرة السرير.

scenes.en: I get up at six thirty.
scenes.ar: أنهض من السرير الساعة السادسة والنصف.

scenes.en: I get up and open the window.
I get up early for school.
I get up slowly on weekends.
scenes.ar: أنهض ببطء في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

story.en: Omar wakes up at six.
He stays in bed for five minutes.
Then he gets up and starts his day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you get up right away?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, I get up after a few minutes.

items.title: In the morning
items.formula: In the morning + جملة / I + فعل + in the morning
items.explanation: تستخدم In the morning لفترة الصباح عمومًا، لا لوقت ساعة محدد. ويمكن وضعها في بداية الجملة أو آخرها.
items.explanationEn: In the morning names a part of the day, not one exact clock time.
items.contrast: In the morning = خلال الصباح، At seven = عند الساعة السابعة.

scenes.en: In the morning, I drink water.
I study English in the morning.
In the morning, the streets are quiet.
I take a short walk in the morning.

story.en: Sara loves the quiet morning.
In the morning, she drinks water.
Then she reads for ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When do you study?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I study in the morning.

items.title: I brush my teeth
items.formula: I brush my teeth + before / after + اسم أو فعل-ing
items.explanation: نقول brush my teeth لا wash my teeth. ويمكن ربط العادة بوقت محدد مثل after breakfast.
items.explanationEn: Say brush my teeth for cleaning teeth with a toothbrush.
items.contrast: Brush my teeth لتنظيف الأسنان، Wash my face لغسل الوجه.

scenes.en: I brush my teeth every morning.
I brush my teeth after breakfast.
I brush my teeth before bed.
I brush my teeth for two minutes.

story.en: Ali finishes breakfast.
He brushes his teeth carefully.
He smiles before leaving home.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you brush your teeth before bed?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I brush my teeth every night.

items.title: I have breakfast
items.explanation: في الوجبات نقول have breakfast أو eat breakfast، وغالبًا لا نضع a قبل breakfast.
items.explanationEn: Have breakfast means eat your morning meal. Usually do not add a before breakfast.
items.contrast: Have breakfast = تناول وجبة الإفطار؛ Have a sandwich = تناول شطيرة.

scenes.en: I have breakfast at seven.
I have breakfast with my family.
I have breakfast before school.
I have breakfast at home.

story.en: The family sits at the table.
They have breakfast together.
Nour says, 'I have breakfast at home.'
story.ar: تقول نور: أتناول الإفطار في المنزل.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Where do you have breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I have breakfast at home.

items.title: I go to
items.explanation: نستخدم المضارع البسيط لوصف الذهاب المتكرر. نقول go to school أو go to work، لكن go home دون to.
items.explanationEn: Use go to for regular destinations, but say go home without to.
items.contrast: I go to school / I go to work، لكن I go home.

scenes.en: I go to school five days a week.
scenes.ar: أذهب إلى المدرسة خمسة أيام في الأسبوع.

scenes.en: I go to work by bus.
I go to the park after school.
I go to the library on Thursday.

story.en: Maya puts on her backpack.
She goes to school with her friend.
She says, 'I go to school every weekday.'
story.ar: تقول: أذهب إلى المدرسة كل يوم دراسي.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How do you go to school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I go to school by bus.

items.title: I usually
items.explanation: Usually تعني حدوث الفعل في معظم الأوقات، وليس في كل مرة. تأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي، ولكن بعد am/is/are.
items.explanationEn: Usually describes something that happens most of the time, but not always.
items.contrast: Always = دائمًا، Usually = عادةً، Sometimes = أحيانًا.

scenes.en: I usually wake up at six.
I usually walk to school.
I usually eat rice for lunch.
I usually read before bed.

story.en: Omar has a simple routine.
He usually walks to school.
On rainy days, he takes the bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you usually walk to school?
dialogue.ar: هل تذهب إلى المدرسة مشيًا عادةً؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I usually walk.

items.title: I always
items.explanation: Always تشير إلى عادة ثابتة في كل مرة تقريبًا. توضع قبل الفعل الرئيسي، وبعد be في مثل I am always ready.
items.explanationEn: Always means every time. Put it before most main verbs.
items.contrast: Always أقوى من Usually: دائمًا مقابل عادةً.

scenes.en: I always wash my hands before eating.
I always brush my teeth at night.
I always carry my keys.
I always say good morning.

story.en: Lina always checks her bag.
She always carries her notebook.
Then she leaves for school.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you always bring your notebook?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I always bring it.

items.title: I often
items.explanation: Often تعني أن الفعل يتكرر كثيرًا، ولكن ليس بالضرورة معظم الأيام. وهي عادةً أقل قوة من usually.
items.explanationEn: Often means many times, though not every time.
items.contrast: Usually = في معظم المرات؛ Often = في مرات كثيرة؛ Sometimes = أحيانًا.

scenes.en: I often visit my grandparents.
I often play football after school.
scenes.ar: ألعب كرة القدم كثيرًا بعد المدرسة.

scenes.en: I often go to the library.
I often help my mother.

story.en: Nour likes spending time outside.
story.ar: تحب نور قضاء الوقت خارج المنزل.

story.en: She often plays with her friends.
After playing, she helps at home.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you often visit the library?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I often visit it on Thursdays.

items.title: I sometimes
items.explanation: Sometimes لشيء يقع من حين إلى آخر. يمكن وضعها قبل الفعل أو في أول الجملة، مع مراعاة الفاصلة.
items.explanationEn: Sometimes describes an action that happens now and then.
items.contrast: Often = كثيرًا؛ Sometimes = أحيانًا؛ Never = أبدًا.

scenes.en: I sometimes watch TV after dinner.
I sometimes walk to work.
I sometimes eat fruit for breakfast.
I sometimes study with my friends.

story.en: Ali usually studies alone.
Sometimes, his friends join him.
They learn new words together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you always study alone?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, I sometimes study with friends.

items.title: I never
items.explanation: Never تحمل النفي بنفسها، لذلك لا نضيف don't معها في الإنجليزية القياسية. نقول I never skip breakfast.
items.explanationEn: Never already makes the sentence negative. Do not add don't before never.
items.contrast: I never eat late صحيحة؛ I don't never eat late غير صحيحة في الإنجليزية القياسية.

scenes.en: I never skip breakfast.
I never forget my school bag.
I never drink coffee at night.
I never go to bed very late.
scenes.ar: لا أذهب إلى الفراش متأخرًا جدًا أبدًا.

story.en: Sara plans her school day.
She never forgets her lunch box.
She checks her bag before leaving.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you ever skip breakfast?
dialogue.ar: هل تفوت الإفطار في أي وقت؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, I never skip breakfast.

items.title: I eat
items.formula: I eat + طعام + at / for + وجبة
items.explanation: Eat يتحدث عن تناول الطعام، ويمكن تحديد ما نأكله أو وقت الوجبة. لا نستخدم eat مع المشروبات بل drink.
items.explanationEn: Use eat with food, and drink with water, milk, or other beverages.
items.contrast: I eat apples، لكن I drink water.

scenes.en: I eat lunch at one.
I eat an apple after school.
I eat vegetables every day.
I eat dinner with my family.

story.en: Omar comes home after school.
story.ar: يعود عمر إلى المنزل بعد المدرسة.

story.en: He eats lunch with his family.
Then he rests for a short time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you eat for lunch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I eat rice and vegetables.

items.title: Before I
items.formula: Before I + فعل مضارع، جملة رئيسية
items.explanation: تربط Before I بين حدثين، وتحدد ما يحدث أولًا. يمكن تقديم before أو وضعها بعد الجملة الرئيسية.
items.explanationEn: Before I links two actions and tells what happens first.
items.contrast: Before I sleep, I read = القراءة أولًا؛ After I sleep, I wake up = النوم أولًا.

scenes.en: Before I leave, I check my bag.
Before I eat, I wash my hands.
Before I sleep, I read a book.
Before I study, I clean my desk.

story.en: Maya gets ready for school.
Before she leaves, she checks her bag.
Then she walks to the bus stop.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you do before you eat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Before I eat, I wash my hands.

items.title: After I
items.formula: After I + فعل مضارع، جملة رئيسية
items.explanation: After I ترتب حدثًا يقع بعد حدث آخر. يمكن استخدام After + verb-ing حين لا نذكر الفاعل من جديد.
items.explanationEn: After I introduces an action that happens before the main action.
items.contrast: Before I eat, I wash = أغسل أولًا؛ After I eat, I wash = آكل أولًا.

scenes.en: After I wake up, I drink water.
After I study, I take a break.
After I eat lunch, I rest.
After I brush my teeth, I go to bed.
scenes.ar: بعد أن أنظف أسناني، أذهب إلى الفراش.

story.en: Ali finishes his homework.
After he studies, he takes a short break.
story.ar: بعد أن يدرس، يأخذ استراحة قصيرة.

story.en: Then he plays with his brother.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you do after school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: After I get home, I eat lunch.
dialogue.ar: بعد أن أصل إلى المنزل، أتناول الغداء.

items.title: Every day
items.formula: I + فعل بالمضارع البسيط + every day
items.explanation: Every day كلمتان تعنيان كل يوم وتصفان التكرار. أما Everyday كلمة واحدة فهي صفة قبل الاسم مثل everyday routine.
items.explanationEn: Every day means each day. Everyday is an adjective, as in everyday routine.
items.contrast: I read every day = كل يوم؛ My everyday routine = روتيني اليومي.

scenes.en: I practice English every day.
I drink water every day.
I walk for twenty minutes every day.
I write three sentences every day.

story.en: Nour wants to improve her English.
She learns a few words every day.
After a week, she sees progress.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How often do you practice English?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I practice English every day.

items.title: At night
items.explanation: At night لتحديد فترة الليل؛ نقول in the morning وفي المقابل at night. لا تستخدم in the night لوصف العادة اليومية المعتادة.
items.explanationEn: Use at night for regular nighttime activities.
items.contrast: In the morning، In the afternoon، In the evening، لكن At night.

scenes.en: At night, I read a short story.
I brush my teeth at night.
At night, the street is quiet.
I turn off my phone at night.

story.en: The day is almost over.
At night, Omar reads a short story.
Then he turns off the light.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you do at night?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: At night, I read and rest.

items.title: I go to bed
items.formula: I go to bed + at + وقت
items.explanation: Go to bed تعني الذهاب للفراش استعدادًا للنوم، وهي تختلف عن fall asleep التي تعني الدخول الفعلي في النوم.
items.explanationEn: Go to bed means prepare to sleep; fall asleep means begin sleeping.
items.contrast: I go to bed at ten؛ I fall asleep at ten fifteen.

scenes.en: I go to bed at nine.
I go to bed after reading.
I go to bed early on school nights.
scenes.ar: أذهب للفراش مبكرًا في ليالي الدراسة.

scenes.en: I go to bed when I feel sleepy.

story.en: Sara finishes her evening routine.
She says good night to her family.
She goes to bed at nine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time do you go to bed?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I go to bed at nine.

items.title: On weekends
items.formula: On weekends + جملة / I + فعل + on weekends
items.explanation: On weekends شائعة في الإنجليزية الأمريكية؛ at weekends شائعة في البريطانية. كلاهما يصف العادة في أيام العطلة.
items.explanationEn: On weekends describes regular weekend habits in American English.
items.contrast: On weekends (أمريكي)، At weekends (بريطاني)، On Saturday (يوم محدد).

scenes.en: On weekends, I visit my grandparents.
scenes.ar: في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع أزور جدي وجدتي.

scenes.en: I play football on weekends.
scenes.ar: ألعب كرة القدم في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

scenes.en: On weekends, I wake up later.
scenes.ar: أستيقظ متأخرًا أكثر في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

scenes.en: I spend time with my family on weekends.
scenes.ar: أقضي وقتًا مع أسرتي في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع.

story.en: The school week is over.
On weekends, Maya visits her grandparents.
story.ar: في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع تزور مايا جديها.

story.en: She feels happy with her family.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you do on weekends?
dialogue.ar: ماذا تفعل في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I visit my grandparents on weekends.
dialogue.ar: أزور جدي وجدتي في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع.

lines.en: I usually wake up at six.
I get up and open the window.
In the morning, I drink water.
I have breakfast with my family.
Before I leave, I check my bag.
I go to school five days a week.
lines.ar: أذهب إلى المدرسة خمسة أيام في الأسبوع.

lines.en: I often study with my friends.
I sometimes eat fruit for lunch.
After I get home, I eat lunch.
lines.ar: بعد أن أصل إلى المنزل، أتناول الغداء.

lines.en: On weekends, I wake up later.
lines.ar: في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع أستيقظ متأخرًا أكثر.

lines.en: Sometimes, I play football with friends.
lines.ar: أحيانًا ألعب كرة القدم مع أصدقائي.

lines.en: At night, I read a short story.
